en-US.author: Dave Weaver
en-US.description: Keep every coding-agent workspace alive at once and switch projects instantly.
en-US.longDescription:
Silo is for developers juggling coding agents across many projects. Keep every project running simultaneously — terminals, agents, and layout intact — and switch between them instantly. 100% open source and free forever.

The problem with one-workspace-at-a-time editors
VS Code and Cursor are file-first editors. They're built around a single active workspace — which made sense when you were writing the code.
Now you're coordinating 3–5 AI coding agents simultaneously across different projects. Every time you switch context, you lose your terminal state. Your agents get interrupted. You spend more time rebuilding context than doing actual work.
Silo is built around the opposite model.
Open as many project workspaces as you need and tab between them instantly. Each workspace keeps its terminals running, its layout intact, and its agents working — exactly as you left it. Switching takes a keystroke, not a minute.

How it works
- Instant switching, zero reload — each project gets its own persistent tab; switch instantly without losing anything
- Free and open source, forever — MIT licensed, no subscription, no account, no enterprise tier; fork it, contribute to it, build on it
- Local-first — everything runs on your machine; no cloud sync, no telemetry, no account required
- Layout that sticks — each workspace remembers its exact terminal tab arrangement; name tabs for specific jobs and they're waiting exactly where you left them
- Terminals and editors as equals — a terminal tab and an editor tab are the same thing; arrange them side by side, stack them, name them; span a workspace across multiple folders for monorepos or paired projects
- Extension SDK — every built-in feature ships as an extension against the same public API you get; browse and install from extensions.getsilo.dev or Settings → Extensions

Who it's for
- You run Claude Code, Aider, or other AI coding agents and want to keep several going at once
- You work across multiple projects simultaneously and hate losing terminal state when switching
- You live in the terminal more than the editor
- You've hit the ceiling of what a single-workspace editor can do for your workflow
en-US.name: Silo
en-US.releaseNotes:
This is the first public release since v0.79.0. It also includes everything from v0.80.0, v0.81.0 and v0.81.1, whose builds were never published. All of those changes are listed below.
0.82.0 (2026-11-09)
Features
- agents-chat-panel,terminal: link file paths that contain spaces (#673) (0005000)
0.81.1 (2026-11-08)
Performance Improvements
- agents: stop persisting the raw protocol frame in the chat journal (#670) (b4dc5cc), closes #665
0.81.0 (2026-11-07)
Features
- sdk: side panel tab icons with per-tab display (#667) (96f634e)
0.80.0 (2026-11-03)
Features
- agents-chat-panel: collapse a long user prompt behind Show more (#661) (21da1f1)
Bug Fixes
- agents-chat-panel: focus the composer after a file drop (#663) (e887f4b)
- agents-chat-panel: unblock the prompt bubble's copy row and sharpen the Prompt Rail (#664) (f29f775)

zh-CN.description: 让所有编码智能体工作区同时保活，切换项目即时恢复。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Silo 专为在多个项目中同时调度编码智能体的开发者打造。保持每个项目同时运行——终端、智能体与布局均完好无损——并在它们之间即时切换。100% 开源，永久免费。

单工作区编辑器的局限
VS Code 和 Cursor 是以文件为优先的编辑器。它们围绕单个活动工作区构建——在你亲自编写代码的时代，这种设计合情合理。
现在，你需要跨不同项目同时协同 3–5 个 AI 编码智能体。每次切换上下文，终端状态都会丢失。你的智能体被迫中断。你花在重建上下文上的时间比实际做开发的时间还要多。
Silo 则基于完全相反的模式构建。
根据需要打开任意数量的项目工作区，并在它们之间即时切换。每个工作区都会保持终端运行、布局原样保留、智能体持续工作——完全维持在你离开时的状态。切换只需敲击一下按键，无需耗费一分钟。

工作原理
- 即时切换，零重新加载——每个项目都有独立的持久标签页；即时切换，无任何状态丢失
- 永久免费且开源——采用 MIT 协议，无订阅制，无需注册账号，无企业版门槛；自由 Fork、贡献代码并基于此二次开发
- 本地优先——所有内容均在本地机器运行；无云端同步，无遥测，无需账号
- 布局记忆固定——每个工作区都会精准记住终端标签页的排布；为特定任务命名标签页，它们就会在离开时的位置原封不动地等待你
- 终端与编辑器平起平坐——终端标签页与编辑器标签页毫无二致；可并排排列、分层堆叠、自定义命名；单个工作区可跨越多个文件夹，轻松适配 Monorepo 或联动项目
- 扩展 SDK——所有内置功能均作为扩展提供，且调用与开放给你的完全相同的公开 API；可通过 extensions.getsilo.dev 或“设置 → 扩展”浏览并安装

适用人群
- 你在使用 Claude Code、Aider 或其他 AI 编码智能体，并希望同时保持多个智能体并行运转
- 你需要同时在多个项目中工作，讨厌在切换时丢失终端状态
- 相比编辑器，你更多时候是在终端中工作
- 单工作区编辑器的能力已经成了你工作流的瓶颈与上限
